name: Resistance Band Squat
steps: Stand on a long band with feet shoulder width apart.
Bring the band handles or loops up to your shoulders.
Push hips back and bend knees to lower down.
Stop when thighs are about parallel or your back starts to round.
Press through your heels to stand against the band.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out as you stand

common_mistakes.fix: Stand on the middle with both feet flat
Keep the band at your shoulders
Push knees out over your toes
